sources.title: Qwen3_ (14B).ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: Data Prep Qwen3 has both reasoning and a non reasoning mode. So, we should use 2 datasets: We use the Open Math Reasoning dataset which was used to win the AIMO (AI Mathematical Olympiad - Progress Prize 2) challenge! We sample 10% of verifiable reasoning traces that used DeepSeek R1, and which got > 95% accuracy.
